requiredSequence: Read current docs/tracker.json and AGENTS.md; use npm run progress -- --closure-next to select one existing open task assigned to your lane.
Inspect that exact task's accept criteria, latest main HEAD, migration registration, consumer behavior, executable witnesses, and CI receipts before touching code.
State a finite single-task closure hypothesis and all missing proof; prefer an acceptance-ready task with registered PG and live producer/consumer over a source-only candidate.

Implement the smallest correct blocker fix and meaningful negative tests in one cohesive owned-domain batch; use L01 for numbered migrations/shared schema and L10 for independent verification; do not bypass lane ownership.

Execute focused proof on exact main SHA, including registered schema/tenant/privacy/race/consumer requirements for that specific task; source-only, staged-only, queued, cancelled, or a success from unrelated older commit is not acceptance.

If and only if every scoped engineering gate passes, atomically record done:true, acceptedAt and executed acceptanceEvidence in the same sole tracker with fresh GitHub blob SHA; freeze this task and immediately select the next OPEN task.

After two passes without task acceptance, document one precise executable blocker and named owner, hand off shared migration/verification to the owning lane and MOVE to another independent ready OPEN task; never run a third pass of the same speculative audit.

Before ending, report only changed accepted count, accepted IDs, exact run URLs and remaining named blockers. Never call unverified staging closure, global database certification, or release completion.
